sections.heading: C2 — Passing and following distance
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Passing and following distance

FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A78
Do not join a funeral procession or drive between its vehicles unless a police officer authorizes it. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A78
On a multilane highway, do not pass a funeral procession in the right lane unless the procession occupies the farthest-left lane. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A78
Do not enter an intersection across a funeral procession's path while it is passing through, regardless of the traffic signal's color. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A78
Give funeral processions the right of way. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A78
Every funeral-procession vehicle must use its headlights and taillights. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A78
The first and last vehicles in a funeral procession must also flash warning lights to mark its endpoints. [A78]
Source: [A78 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A79
A vehicle below normal traffic speed that delays at least three vehicles in a rural area or on a two-lane highway must pull off wherever safe to let them pass. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A79
A vehicle designed for no more than twenty-five miles an hour may use public highways only from thirty minutes before sunrise to thirty minutes after sunset, except snow-removal or farm equipment on non-interstate highways with flashing lights visible for five hundred feet. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A79
Slow-moving vehicles must have a foot brake and turn signals and display the approved slow-vehicle emblem. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A79
Tailgating means following too closely and is a common cause of crashes. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R11 | anchor: A79
When following another car, leave enough space to stop when needed. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R12 | anchor: A79
Keep the brakes in good working condition when relying on a following gap. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R13 | anchor: A79
Know the brakes' stopping performance in different conditions and test them often, especially on wet, icy or snowy roads. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R14 | anchor: A79
The handbook's minimum recommended following interval is three seconds, with more distance needed at high speeds or in bad weather. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R15 | anchor: A79
For the recommended following-gap check, select a stationary reference ahead of the lead vehicle, such as a tree or roadside sign. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R16 | anchor: A79
Begin counting three seconds when the vehicle ahead passes the chosen object. [A79]
Source: [A79 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R17 | anchor: A80
In the handbook's reference-object check, the interval before reaching the object should be at least three seconds and several times longer in bad weather. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec09-R18 | anchor: A80
Maintain space around the vehicle on all sides to provide time to react to danger. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec09-R19 | anchor: A80
Stay near the center of the lane and leave enough space ahead to stop or pass safely. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec09-R20 | anchor: A80
If another vehicle follows too closely, slow down and allow it to pass. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec09-R21 | anchor: A80
On a public road, park parallel to and within eighteen inches of the curb or road edge, facing the traffic direction on that side. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec09-R22 | anchor: A80
For a parked vehicle with an automatic transmission, shift to Park; for a manual transmission, leave it in gear. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec09-R23 | anchor: A80
Remove the keys and secure the parked vehicle. [A80]
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0080]

ranked.label: Park with correct spacing and security

corpus_stability.reason: Corpus is the frozen July handbook snapshot; future issuer changes require a new source registration, rather than silent updates to this corpus.

verification_debt.claim_text: The parking paragraph on physical page eighty attaches an only-if-left-running parenthesis to setting the parking brake. The modifier's intended application is unclear and is not converted into advice to omit a parking brake when the engine is off; issuer clarification is required.
